gates.quality: 2/2 correct visual descriptions: rectangle with exactly one left-side gap; blank image has no room/doors/dimensions. No metric scale or safe-fit claim. First case has exactly one expected (2,1) proposal; blank has none.
gates.fast: 2/2 intents correct: exact synthetic-chair target at (2.2,1), with 20cm=0.2m explanation and no execution claim; ambiguity asks clarification and emits no tool.
gates.failure: Truncated response is rejected and releases zero proposals. Existing offline refusal/error/invalid-field tests must pass. Zero project writes by construction.
gates.latency: Initial investigation ceiling (not SLA): each edit_fast <=10s total and <=5s first text when text exists; design_quality <=30s total and <=10s first text when text exists. Missing timing fails latency qualification. One sample per case cannot establish reliability or percentiles.

cases.prompt: Describe the visible content of this attached image, including any discontinuities and their side relative to the image. Is its real-world scale known? Separately, propose moving synthetic-chair in synthetic-candidate to x=2,z=1. Do not execute.
Describe what is visible in this attached image. Can you determine a room shape, doors or dimensions? This is a question only; do not change anything.

In synthetic-candidate, the uniquely selected synthetic-chair is at x=2,z=1 metres. Image-right is world +x. Explain whether 20 centimetres equals 0.2 metres, and propose moving only that chair image-right by 20 centimetres, retaining z. This is a proposal; placement validation will happen later.
Move it a bit over there. Nothing is selected and there is no direction or distance. Ask the necessary question, without guessing or changing the candidate.
Propose moving synthetic-chair in synthetic-candidate to x=2,z=1. Give a full explanation and the complete tool request.

system: This is an isolated validation. Tools propose edits only; no executor exists. Never claim edits have happened. Only propose an edit explicitly requested by the user for a unique target. Ambiguous requests require clarification without tools. Image coordinates have no verified metric scale: do not infer metres, bearing walls, compass directions, collision clearance or that furniture fits from pixels. Describe visible content, not expected fixture content. Respond concisely.
